Thanks Maria — quick confirmation and checklist from our side so we can process this cleanly:

1) We require a signed vendor bank change authorization (scanned signature) OR a bank letter on bank letterhead that references the account and a contact at the bank.
2) W-9 on file must match the tax ID used for payments — I see the W-9 you attached; please confirm the EIN on the signed form you will send matches that PDF.
3) For open POs (PO# 78942), we will issue an amendment to update remittance instructions; please confirm whether you'd like us to create a PO amendment (PO-78942-1) or to reroute payments without issuing a formal amendment.

I've looped in Olga (AP) to initiate the vendor record update and Lauren (procurement) to handle the PO amendment. Once we receive the signed bank-change form we will:
- create internal ticket and vendor-record task
- update vendor portal record
- issue PO amendment (if you opt for one) and notify AP for payment scheduling

If you can send the signed form (or bank letter with signature) I’ll prioritize this and aim to complete the update within 1–2 business days after receipt.

Best,
